text: Penguins are black and white flightless birds found in Northrend and Kul Tiras. Some tuskarr breed penguins as farm animals. It seems that a number of wild penguins are led by a large member of the race known as the Penguin King. Tundra penguins often gather in large groups on the ice for protection against aquatic threats. Unfortunately this makes them easy prey for humanoid hunters seeking meat, skins and other achievements.
__NOTOC__ Pephredo was a jungle troll mage trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar, standing near Deino and Enyo.

On September 30, goblin vendors arrived in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar. These vendors sold fireworks at discounted prices. The reason? So that everyone might celebrate the day that was saved by the hard work of the mighty peon and the great peasant! Legend has it that long ago, the leaders of the two races, orc and human, each called upon a lowly worker and assigned him a great task. This task had to be finished by the end of the day, lest the world suffer grave consequence. Working diligently, both completed their task four minutes before the day ended. Thus, on the anniversary of that day, we celebrate in honor of all the peons and peasants everywhere. Peon Day coincides with the annivers

Perception is a human racial ability that temporarily increases stealth detection by 50 points, equivalent to 10 levels.

The Perenolde Tiara drops from Grel'borg the Miser in the Alterac Mountains. It is an heirloom of the Perenolde family, fitted with fine emeralds and said to have been crafted by master jewelers in Ironforge. Count Remington Ridgewell asked adventurers to retrieve it so he can exhibit it in his family museum.

The Pendant of the Sea Lion combines the agility needed to dodge aquatic predators with the endurance needed to remain submerged indefinitely. During the quest Trial of the Sea Lion, a young druid searches for Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance, and combines them at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

Pepa Sandtoe is a dead shot. She is short — short even for a gnome. Always overlooked as a child, she developed a watchful eye and allowed little to escape her gaze. Even in gnome society, her elders considered her too small to excel in much. Always able to beat her brothers and sisters at skipping stones and other throwing games, she caught the eye of her uncle, a weapons engineer. He trained her in throwing knives and axes. Praising her sharp eye, he introduced her to bows. She worked a great deal on her upper body strength, and when she turned 15, her uncle gave her her first firearm. She was killed along with the other escorts by members of the Horde who wished to steal the artifact. She was betrothed to Banagos, who discovered her body and tended to it.

Pelagos is an Eternal One serving as the Arbiter, the being who rules over the Eternal City of Oribos and is responsible for judging mortal souls in the Shadowlands and assigning them to appropriate afterlives. He was formerly a mere aspirant of the kyrian who struggled to find his place in the afterlife of Bastion, but who—alongside his soulbind, Kleia—found himself caught up in the momentous events unfolding across the Shadowlands. He volunteered to become the Arbiter in order to fill the vacancy created by the loss of the previous Arbiter. in the center.]] The perfect ones were a new, powerful type of centaur created by an unnamed earth elemental after the Cataclysm. They were led by the High Khan Aratas, who sought to unite Kalimdor's centaur tribes and conquer the whole of Azeroth, but they were stopped by the Garad'kra.
The Perenolde family is the former royal family of the kingdom of Alterac. It originally lived in the palace of Alterac City.

The Pet Rock is looted from Ending Treasure Chest, an object that can only be spawned using the Never Ending Toy Chest toy. Prior to Cataclysm, it was obtainable via the rogue's Pickpocket ability. It could only be found in the pockets of Timbermaw Shaman.

Peria Lamenur is a dwarf pet trainer located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. She also appears on the Ironforge Airstrip and can be seen cheering with two mountaineers. As to why, it can be assumed because they are defeating the trolls that continue to attack the front line. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Perry Gatner is a stand-up comedian who occasionally appears in the World's End Tavern in Shattrath City. He tells a variety of jokes as well as impersonations of the various playable races. Haris Pilton makes a few comments about his jokes. Shattrath Saul lets you know about the act saying: : :

Prior to Patch 5.0.4, hunter pets enjoyed their own talent system, featuring trees in which hunters could spend each pet's talent points. The pet talent system was removed with Mists of Pandaria, with many talents removed, and the rest converted into specialization-specific pet abilities.

:"With each breath, I can sense that you are one step closer to death." ::– Saeryn Dusksorrow Pestilence is a death knight ability that allows the Death Knight to spread their Frost Fever and Blood Plague from one target to other nearby targets within 10 yards. The minor Glyph of Pestilence can increase the range of spreading diseases by 5 yards. It costs 1 Blood Rune to cast.
Pet Barding is a pet talent located in the 2nd tier of the Tenacity Tree.

Unlike most of the Love is in the Air achievements, Perma-Peddle is not part of the meta-achievement, Fool For Love. A Truesilver Shafted Arrow may be purchased for from a Lovely Merchant in any capital city.

Perixa is, along with Branzlit, Kixa and Rilgiz one of four bankers in the Bank of Orgrimmar which is located in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. After the failed Battle for Broken Shore, she was seen talking with an Orgrimmar Grunt. After Vol'jin's funeral, she was speaking with Grunt Soran.

The Pet Journal is a window tab found in the Collections interface. It provides listings and details concerning non-combat pets both collected and not collected, as well as allowing players to queue for pet battles as part of the Pet Battle System. It also provides access to the Revive Battle Pets ability, as well as the 'Summon' button used to select a particular pet to be the player's in-game companion.
Perk Up is an ability used by skunks and other pets during a Pet Battle.
Perfumed Arrow is an ability used by Peddlefeet during a Pet Battle.

Pet Tamers are NPCs that the player can fight using the Pet Battle System. They are located around the world, with pets ranging from beginner's level to master. In order to fight pet tamers for the first time, you must have the appropriate quest sending you to fight them. You obtain the first of these quests from your battle pet trainer located in either Stormwind City or Orgrimmar when your pet reaches level 3. There are prizes and achievements for winning against pet tamers. Defeating all of the tamers in any region will open up pet battle daily quests within that region. The Personal Spotlight makes a beam of light over the caster, similar to that of an Elder's Moonstone. The beam lasts for an hour but is only visible to the caster.

Permafrost Walls are four large ice walls found in Icecrown Citadel during the second stage of The Frozen Flame. All four need to be destroyed to progress further into the citadel and to progress into the next stage of the quest.

Periodic Destruction is an achievement that is earned by killing all the elemental mini-bosses that can be summoned in Mardivas's Laboratory. In the course of the weekly quest The Laboratory of Mardivas players use the Arcane Reagents Strange Volcanic Rock, Strange Mineralized Water, or Strange Oceanic Sediment to activate minor and major arcanocrystals in the laboratory. The player must first activate a minor arcanocrystal (Benthic, Lithic or Pyroclasmic), then must activate a major arcanocrystal (Benthic, Lithic or Pyroclasmic), and then activate the Elemental Essence Amalgamator to summon an elemental. An ancient horror lurks in these twisting paths of Phantom Grove, turning away all but the most stalwart of champions. These would-be heroes enter confidently, seeking battle and adventure to immortalize their legacy...but none have returned.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps7.shtml]

The Pig and Whistle Tavern is a tavern and inn in Stormwind City. Located in the district known as Old Town, the Pig and Whistle is home away from home for the weary Alliance traveler. Kendor Kabonka can be found here, as well as soldiers recalling the First and Second Wars. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, the tavern was taken by the Veiled Hand cultists including Althea Ebonlocke. She was killed by Garona Halforcen and the Shadow of the Uncrowned. Several fel braziers could be seen.
Pickled Kodo Feet can be purchased for from in Mulgore, Elwynn Forest or Terokkar Forest during the Darkmoon Faire.

Phantasmal Lashs are lashers found at the southernmost den of the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade. These lashers are phenomena of the Emerald Dream that have made their way to Azeroth. They are currently being kept in check by Cenarion Dreamwardens.

This draught is composed of phlogiston gas mixed with rare herbs and minerals. Consuming the elixir will increase and decrease the effectiveness of some of your abilities. A phlogiston elixir is almost as unstable as the pure substance. After a number of days, the elixir starts to break down, turning the elixir into an ingested poison.
Phillip Harding is a Forsaken flight master located at Strahnbrad in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He is accompanied by Gol'dir.

The unicycle is a favorite of both goblins and gnomes for rapid transportation on city streets. While uncommon in the cities of humans except during performance expositions, unicycles are common in Ratchet as an eccentric form of transportation. The infamous Slink Strong, goblin performer extraordinaire, bases his "line of death" stunt on a reliable, Ratchet-designed phlogistic unicycle and 10 pulley guns firing a spider silk line. These one-wheeled devices can move with sartling speed and perform maneuvers of such finesse they almost seem like a natural extension of the driver. Piera Coppola is the voice actress for Sylvanas Windrunner, Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne and World of Warcraft. Later, Sylvanas was voiced by her until World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King during the The Battle For The Undercity (Horde) in patch 3.2.0 by Patty Mattson.

Pip Quickwit is a gnomish inventor, explorer, and a quest giver. Testing his lava suit, he was found at the Furnace in Upper Blackrock Spire within The Beast's stomach and was released by adventurers when The Beast was killed and skinned. In Cataclysm he also appears at the Circle of Cinders in Mount Hyjal, in various locations of Blackrock Caverns, and in the Den of the Devourer at Blackwing Descent. While in the mountain, he barely escaped Beauty and her pups. He also created and lost a mace and an extremely well-made knife. Pin is one of the pet abilities that only crabs can use. Unlike other Hunter pet slows, it is a not an instant-cast.

Pimento is a horse located at the Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro Crater. He is the loyal steed of Maximillian of Northshire. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Maximillian and Pimento were in Highmountain.

She can be found at the Hissing Grotto in the Waking Shores. She can be found walking up and down the hill, throwing pool ponies into the ocean.

The Pilfered Gearglider was a flying disc that was never made available. It would likely have been obtained in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Piled Rubble is found in Provis Esper in Zereth Mortis. The player needs to interact with all the individual pieces of rubble to destroy them and reveal a lootable Conduction Remnant on the ground for Remnants of the First Ones.

Pine Flickers are birds located in the Azure Span. They will fly up and away when a player approaches.

.]] The Plague of Undeath (blight or simply the Plague) is a magical affliction first conjured by Ner'zhul, the Lich King (under the direction of the demon lord Kil'jaeden), from his icy prison within the Frozen Throne in Northrend in order to create the Scourge. The Scourge was intended to be a vanguard for the Burning Legion, Ner'zhul's captors, during their attack on Azeroth.

Plaguemist Ravine is a pathway in the Hinterlands which leads north to Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. It is located northwest of Quel'Danil Lodge, and the entrance to it can be found within the woods west of Quel'Danil Lodge at on the other side of the mountain. This can also be found to the north of Rhapsody Shindigger at Shindigger's Camp. There are no mobs or NPCs in this subzone. The name "Plaguemist Ravine" was given recently, as the plaguing mist from the pathway is a stark contrast to the natural freshness of the rest of the Hinterlands.

, overseen by a Deatholme Necromancer.]] Plague cauldrons (aka Scourge cauldrons) are giant cauldrons filled with the vile toxins and poisons of the Scourge. Infused with the necromantic sorcery of Kel'Thuzad, these cauldrons are constantly boiling and spewing the Plague of Undeath into the air; corrupting and twisting the land, and empowering the agents of the Scourge. Each of the cauldrons has its own unique mix of toxins and is guarded by a Cauldron Lord with a retinue of formidable Scourge soldiers. In every loot distribution system, there's a way to "earn" points, or more generally, to increase one's probability to receive future loot. When considering rewards, it is most important to be aware what exactly is rewarded. Zero Sum systems in their pure form for example only reward presence at the moment of loot distribution. If on a raid no (or very little) loot was distributed because it was a learning run for a new boss encounter, it doesn't feel fair that the members should go empty handed. :Not to be confused with Sands of Nasam, also in Borean Tundra. The Plains of Nasam are a region of the Borean Tundra southwest of Warsong Hold. Kel'Thuzad, the lieutenant of the Lich King, stands on a large dais here, surrounded by skeletons, ghouls and abominations. Devices called Scourge Plague Spreaders can also be found here changing the land. In the quest The Plains of Nasam, Horde players are called on to drive a Horde siege tank, destroy the undead around the region, rescue injured Warsong Hold troops, and identify the leader of the Scourge forces (Kel'Thuzad).

Plagued Vermin are rats that have been affected by eating plagued grain from the Conspicuous Crates found in towns and the plagued corpses littering the streets. They are part of the Zombie infestation world event. Attacking one causes the attacker to become infected. Unlike Plagued Roaches, the Plagued Vermins aggro city guards. These will become infected, and will turn into zombies if not cleansed fast enough. Killing them with a pet will prevent them from spreading the plague.

A player character (PC) in World of Warcraft (WoW) is an in-game Alliance or Horde character controlled by you or another person (also known as a player). When you first start playing the game, you create a character for yourself, and you play the game as that character. Also referred to as just a player or a character. Some other names used: *Alt or Main *Avatar *Toon *Adventurer, champion, or hero (in-universe) Player characters are just one type of in-game character; see Non-Player characters (NPCs). Fighting another player character is called Player versus Player (PvP).

Plunder Isle is an island located in the eastern section of the South Seas. It is under the control of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and their capital of Bloodsail Hold is located here. After the undead pirate captain Jerias Bloodvein subdued and trained James Blackridge, Liam, and Bram Woodring, the captain sailed the Garrote to the isle where they could unload their loot, reprovision the ship, and the crew got to rest and relax for a few days.

Poisons are abilities that enable Assassination rogues to coat their weapons with poisons. Poisons are considered a temporary (1-hour) weapon enhancement. Poisons do not stack with other temporary weapon effects such as a Blacksmith's sharpening stones or weightstones or Alchemist's oils. Podcasting is the method of distributing multimedia files, such as audio programs or music videos, over the Internet using either the RSS or Atom syndication formats, for playback on mobile devices and personal computers. The term podcast, like "radio," can mean both the content and the method of delivery. The host or author of a podcast is often called a podcaster. Though podcasters' web sites may also offer direct download or streaming of their files, a podcast is distinguished by its ability to be downloaded automatically using software capable of reading RSS or Atom feeds. Usually a podcast features one type of “show,” with new episodes released either sporadically or at planned interval

In World of Warcraft, pop usually means a couple of things: # An abbreviation for population as in server population. # A term generally used to describe any mob that spawns or "pop"s in the general area (usually by surprise). Also called an Add or Respawn by some people. Not a widely used term, but more accurate in some cases than "add" for the situation. It is common to prefix with re- (i.e. repop) when referring to a respawn. # Can mean "Use" sometimes, "Pop your cooldown/trinket/ability" = Use it

The Pools of Aggonar, located in the northern part of Hellfire Peninsula, is the home of Arazzius the Cruel. An eredar warlock and loyal servant of Kil'jaeden — an officer of the Burning Legion — Arazzius resides at his throne on the top of the mountain, protected by many demons. The pools were once sacred springs for the draenei, but were corrupted by the blood of the dying pit lord, Aggonar. The cause of his death is unknown, but his demonic aura quickly corrupted the once holy site and now only his bones remain as a testament to his fate. Portal Clearing, located on the western bank of Marshlight Lake in western Zangarmarsh in Outland, is the location of one of the dimensional gateways which the Burning Legion used to bring demons from the Twisting Nether. Illidan Stormrage, during his rule over the Black Temple, sent his forces to close other portals in Outland, which cut off the flow of demons and ended the extra stresses on the planet's remnants. Certain spells and items allow a player to Possess a target, allowing the player to see through its eyes and control its actions as though the target were the player. As of WoW 2.3, the main action bar changes to reflect the available abilities of the target. Prior to v2.3, the player gained the target's actions via the pet bar. The Pool of Ask'ar is an underwater lake located in a large cavern within Blackfathom Deeps. It is the location of Ghamoo-Ra, and through submerged passageways, Argent Guard Thaelrid and Lady Sarevess. The Lorgalis Manuscript can also be found here. The pool is home to numerous turtles, crabs, and naga. The Pool of Ask'ar lies beyond the Drowned Sacellum, and leads through a long series of tunnels, past Gelihast and Lorgus Jett to the Moonshrine Ruins. Access to these tunnels is on the south side of the pool. es:Alberca de Ask'ar
